requirements.requirement: The system must successfully ingest a realistic NPI API response payload via provider_detail_service without schema errors.
The system must extract credential fields (e.g., provider credentials string) from the NPI response and pass them to the scoring logic.
The system must extract taxonomy codes from the NPI response and pass them to the scoring logic.
The system must extract license-related fields (e.g., state license identifiers if present) from the NPI response and pass them to the scoring logic.
The system must compute a credential completeness score using the extracted NPI fields and return a normalized value within the defined range.
The system must include the credential completeness score in the evaluate_care_facade response payload.
The system must include a component-level breakdown (e.g., credentials, taxonomy, license contributions) in the facade response if defined in the scoring contract.
The system must preserve data consistency such that the fields used in scoring match exactly those extracted from the NPI response.
The system must produce deterministic scoring output for the same NPI input payload across multiple test runs.
The system must handle an NPI response where credential fields are missing by assigning a lower completeness score without throwing an error.
The system must handle an NPI response with an empty taxonomy array by assigning partial or zero contribution for taxonomy without failing the pipeline.
The system must handle malformed or partially structured NPI responses by failing gracefully and returning a controlled error or fallback response.
The system must validate that the facade response schema remains consistent with the contract defined in EVAL-CRED-003.
The system must complete the end-to-end flow (provider_detail_service → scoring → facade) within acceptable test execution time thresholds.
